releaseNotes:
☁️ Cloud File Opening & Direct Restore (v1.1.5) by Dhiraj:
• 📂 Direct Google Drive & Cloud Opening: Fixes opening of backup files shared on the cloud. Tapping a .enc, .bin, or .msgvault file in Google Drive or cloud storage now directly launches MsgVault to decrypt and restore
• 📤 Cloud Share Sheet Integration: Backup files shared via 'Send a copy' or 'Share' from Google Drive or messaging apps are automatically routed to the restore engine
• 🔍 Universal Cloud Picker: Enhanced Google Drive file browser allowing seamless selection of all backup archives without greyed-out files
• 🛡️ Zero-Knowledge On-Device Decryption: Full cryptographic validation of cloud backup streams with instant status updates
